To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the profile of a spectral line is determined mainly by the diffraction at the entrance slit and the objective lens.
the apparent line profile, i.e., the distribution of light intensity in the image plane of a spectrometer, is mainly determined by the diffraction at the entrance slit.
The apparatus profile is determined by the diffraction of the light at the slit openings of the spectrometer.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the quantitative analysis of the apparatus line profile of a prism spectrograph.
the determination of the instrumental profile of a prism spectrometer.
the determination of the apparatus profile of a spectrograph, which is the intensity distribution of the light from a monochromatic source, as recorded photoelectrically or photographically.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the profile of a spectral line is determined by the following factors:1) The spectral purity of the light source.2) The optical system of the spectrometer.3) The photographic emulsion or the photocell.4) The geometrical arrangement of the light source and the spectrometer.5) The method of registration.6) The experimental arrangement.7) The physical conditions of the light source.The spectral purity of the source is the most important factor in determining the profile.

the apparatus profile is primarily determined by diffraction at the entrance and exit apertures of the spectrograph and that other factors which contribute to the profile can only be detected when special precautions are taken to minimize the diffraction effects.
the instrumental profile of a monochromatized source of radiation is determined by the aberration of the optical system of a spectrograph.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the main factors which determine the shape of the profile are the diffraction effects in the slits of the spectrograph, and that the effects of aberrations and of chromatic aberration in the collimator and camera lenses, of the spectral sensitivity of the photoelectric cell, and of the slit width are of secondary importance.
the main part of the instrumental profile is determined by the diffraction at the entrance and exit apertures.
the apparatus profile of the spectral lines is mainly determined by diffraction at the entrance and exit slits of the spectrograph.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the main factor that determines the profile is diffraction at the entrance slit, and that other effects, such as diffraction at the prism, the finite size of the prism, and the finite size of light source, are of minor importance.
the main profile of the spectral line is mainly determined by the diffraction at the slit of the spectrometer.
the instrumental profile is mainly determined by diffraction at the entrance and exit apertures of the spectrograph.
